name: LinkFiliate – Create branded short links, track clicks, and manage all your affiliate URLs
author: schorpy

sections.description:
LinkFiliate is the ultimate WordPress plugin for managing, shortening, and tracking your affiliate and marketing links — all from your own website.

Whether you’re a blogger, marketer, or business owner, LinkFiliate helps you create clean branded links, monitor click performance, and optimize conversions.

Forget messy URLs and confusing spreadsheets — start managing your links in one place with advanced tracking, analytics, and automation tools.

🚀 Why Use LinkFiliate?

Because your links are the backbone of your marketing. With LinkFiliate, you can:
– Shorten and brand affiliate links using your own domain.
– Track every click in real-time.
– Improve trust and click-through rates with clean URLs.
– Secure, organize, and analyze your links — all without leaving WordPress.

Whether you’re managing affiliate campaigns, sponsored content, or custom redirects, LinkFiliate makes it simple and powerful.

🔧 Core Features

🔗 Turn Ugly URLs into Pretty Links

Clean up long or complicated URLs by shortening and cloaking them using your own domain.
Create links like yourdomain.com/product-name.

🔗 Custom URL Shortener with prefix

Create short, clean, and memorable URLs using your own domain — e.g.
www.yoursite.com/go/your-custom-slug.
Perfect for social media, email, or YouTube descriptions.

🔍 Advanced Link Tracking

Track every click with detailed analytics. Gain insights into traffic sources, device types, and performance trends.

💼 Affiliate Link Management

Cloak, categorize, and manage all your affiliate links in one dashboard. Add private notes for internal tracking.

🧩 Easy Integration

Insert links easily using shortcodes or built-in integrations with your favorite page builders (Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, etc).

🔄 Redirection Options

Choose from multiple redirect types (301, 302, 307). Add nofollow, sponsored, or noindex attributes for SEO compliance.

🏷️ UTM Template Builder
Create and apply reusable UTM parameter templates for consistent campaign tracking.

🔲 Built-in QR Code Generator

Instantly create downloadable QR codes for your short links.

Transform your link management today. Install LinkFiliate and take control of your marketing links.
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes! LinkFiliate is built to work with any standard WordPress theme. It integrates seamlessly without requiring theme modifications.

Does this plugin work with custom post types?

Absolutely! You can enable link tracking for any registered custom post type in your WordPress installation.

How is this different from third-party link shorteners?

You own everything. Unlike services like Bitly or TinyURL:

  • Your links stay on your domain (better for branding and trust)
  • No monthly fees or click limits
  • Complete data privacy (your analytics aren’t sold to third parties)
  • Links never expire unless you want them to
  • No risk of service shutdown affecting your links

Who can benefit most from LinkFiliate?

LinkFiliate is perfect for website owners, affiliate marketers, SEO professionals, and digital advertisers who need a powerful way to shorten, cloak, track, and manage links directly inside WordPress.

Does it slow down my site?

No. LinkFiliate is optimized for performance using efficient database queries with proper indexing, background processing for analytics, caching for frequently accessed links, and minimal frontend JavaScript (only when needed).
